author: oh_so_tammy
caption: Replying to @Salonblissdallasga Preparing for the El Niño 2026–2027 winter season means thinking beyond food, water, heat and backup power—it also means thinking about what you’re visibly displaying during a prolonged emergency. If your neighborhood is without electricity while your home is brightly lit, or you’re outside cooking while others may be without food, you’re making your preparedness more visible than necessary. My approach is simple: prepare quietly, stay low-profile, and don’t advertise what you have. #ElNino #ElNino2026 #ElNinoWinter2027 #WinterPreparedness #TammyTheBlackPrepper

caption: Day 24 of 30 Things You’ll Wish You Had BEFORE an Emergency 🚨🍽️ PAPER PLATES + DISPOSABLE UTENSILS! Stock up on: 🍽️ Paper plates & bowls 🥤 Disposable cups 🥄 Biodegradable utensils 🧻 Napkins & paper towels They’re inexpensive, easy to store, and require ZERO water for cleanup.
